clue.text: Hosts taken aback about man's separation

parts.note: MCs are masters of ceremonies, who host events

clue.text: It's hard when having to comprehend landing-place in wartime disputes

clue.text: Brother perhaps joined priest and American composer

clue.text: Scotch and beer sustains a politician

clue.text: Soldiers are grabbing a mouthful by the way

clue.text: Latest score in rugby's entertaining final

clue.text: Retreating army controlled by noble, at the margins, close to battle

by means near or close to

clue.text: Want English butcher back in charge

clue.text: In New York, head for pasta

clue.text: Study conducted about the old British bakery produce

clue.text: Odd tipple drunk by crewman?

the spirit traditionally issued to sailors in the Royal Navy
